Genesis AI, a Robotics Startup, Raises $500 Million

‘We’re working to build the world’s best general-purpose robot,’ says CEO Zhou Xian

By

Genesis AI said today it has raised $500 million in Series A funding that values the barely two-year-old startup at $3.5 billion.

The exceptionally large round was co-led by Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures and Eclipse, with other participants including Durable Capital Partners, Bpifrance, HSG, Nvidia venture-capital arm NVentures, AMD Ventures, Zoom Ventures, Samsung Next and Ericsson Ventures.
